messages:
lena (PM): Dropping the greenlight preflight thread. Need explicit owners for SLA phrasing, monitoring alerts, runbook fallback steps, pricing footnote, and legal signoff. Quick ack + any blockers?
harry (SRE): I'll own SLOs + alert rules + fallback policy. Two asks: confirm hosted vs dedicated floors and permission to run a staged traffic-steer in staging during burnin.
anna (Product): Product ok to accept a slightly higher p99 for long-context models if we document the degradation curve and provide example telemetry. Also need a single-sentence comms line for Sales about Dedicated SLAs.
sam (Sales): Give me a safe one-liner for prospects: "Dedicated deployments include contractual SLAs; pricing & credits negotiated with account teams." Legal will want final wording but this covers immediate asks.
morgan (Docs): I'll draft the public GA readiness page and internal runbook. I need promql alert expressions and the CLI/API snippet to trigger fallback. ETA Friday if SRE supplies artifacts.
harry (SRE): Draft SLOs (proposal): hosted: availability 99.95%, latency_p99 <= 350ms; dedicated: availability 99.9%, latency_p99 <= 500ms; private: contractual. Proposed automated policy: if error_budget_burned_pct > 50% sustained for 10m -> auto-traffic-shift to reserve pool + page oncall. Example alert (placeholder): ```promql
(sum(rate(model_response_error_total[5m])) by (model) / sum(rate(model_requests_total[5m])) by (model)) > 0.05
``` CLI fallback example (placeholder): ```bash
redwood traffic shift --policy fallback --from model-xl --to model-safe --reason error_budget_burn
```
lena (PM): Action items and owners:
- harry: finalize SLO doc + promql alert rules + CLI examples -> due Thu EOD
- morgan: publish GA readiness doc + runbook draft with embedded alerts -> due Fri
- sam: draft customer-facing SLA sentence + internal credit calc proposal -> due Mon
- anna: decide premium SLA gating (post-GA vs pilot) -> due Mon
- oncall-coordinator: confirm GA-week rota & handoff -> due Thu
harry (SRE): I'll also add a staging rehearsal plan and a short playbook for engineers to rehearse the traffic-steer.
morgan (Docs): Once I have the artifacts I'll post the draft to #eng-oncall for review.
legal-bot: Reminder: any public SLA language requires legal review; include credit cap and exclusions.
lena (PM): Please add unresolved blockers to the acceptance sheet: https://intra.redwood/ga-acceptance. If no major objections by Thu EOD we'll mark as "Ready for greenlight" and schedule the launch readout.
harry (SRE): ack.
anna (Product): ack.
sam (Sales): ack.
morgan (Docs): ack.
